Facts: Organized prostitution (selling sex) at a venue. Participants: manager, staff, client manager recruiting clients, etc. Crimes: "引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" (luring, harboring, introducing prostitution) or "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". Also "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女"? Not necessarily forced. It's prostitution, not forced. So appropriate charge: "引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". Also possibly "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" if includes organization. The list includes both "引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" and "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". The facts: they organized a venue, recruited prostitutes, managed. So they organized prostitution. So the appropriate charge is "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". However the list includes "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". Yes.

Also maybe "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女"? Not forced, they are consenting (though maybe coerced). Not indicated forced. So not.

Also "非法获取公民个人信息"? No.

Thus single charge: 组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫.

Check list: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". Yes.
